betterquesting:10.desc:8:
You have successfully harnessed the high temperatures of cosmic creation! This block operates at literal Planck temperatures, containing the primordial heat of the Big Bang within a single cubic meter of alchemical casing.

It is magnificent. It is god-like. And yet... unfortunately, it is still not a GregTech Industrial Blast Furnace. No matter how astronomically hot this machine gets, it absolutely refuses to process your Tungstensteel or Naquadah!

However, do not despair! Thanks to a massive, top-down reconstruction by the engineering division at the Pan-Galactic GregTech Corporation, this furnace has been pushed to the absolute limit of logistical efficiency. It no longer just smelts a single stack; it instantaneously processes its entire internal inventory at once! Better yet, the Corporation has tweaked the alchemical output matrix, granting a massive, magical double bonus yield to everything you smelt. It is the ultimate brute-force processing solution for your empire!
